## Summary

Describe the user or operator impact and the reason for this change.

## Security and recovery

- Does this change policy enforcement, provisioning, updates, signing, or recovery?
- What happens if the operation fails halfway through?

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass.
- [ ] Android lint passes.
- [ ] Release APK builds.
- [ ] Publisher tests pass when update tooling changed.
- [ ] Physical-device behavior was tested or the reason it was not is documented.

## Device matrix

List Android versions, vendors, emulators, or physical devices used.
